rule.statement: A high standard of proof is required in disciplinary proceedings against attorneys, involving a suggestion of criminality, deceit, or moral turpitude.
rule.supporting_quote: Proof beyond a reasonable doubt is not necessary, but something more than a balancing of the scales is necessary to enable the Court to have the desired feeling of comfortable satisfaction. A very high standard of proof is required where there are allegations involving a suggestion of criminality, deceit or moral turpitude.
